title: Error when adding Autoload
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
- v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1]
- v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439]
- v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e]

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9186) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700K (24 threads) - 31.74 GiB memory

### Issue description

Whenever I add an Autoload, an error shows up in the Output window:

```
ERROR: scene/main/window.cpp:1069 - Attempting to make child window exclusive, but the parent window already has another exclusive child. This window: /root/@EditorNode@18065/@Panel@14/@VBoxContainer@15/DockHSplitMain/DockVSplitLeftR/DockSlotLeftBR/FileSystem/@ScriptCreateDialog@6584, parent window: /root, current exclusive child window: /root/@EditorNode@18065/@Panel@14/@ProjectSettingsEditor@2298
```

I don't see any ill effects of the error, but it comes up every time for every project except for 1 of them. I'm not sure what is different about the working project, so I've attached it and the reproduction project below.

### Steps to reproduce

### New project steps

1. Open Godot.
2. Create a new project.
3. In the menu, click _Project_ > _Project Settings..._
4. Select the _Globals_ tab.
5. Select the _Autoload_ subtab.
6. Click in the _Node Name_ box and type a name (e.g. Test).
7. Click the _+ Add_ button.

### MRP steps

1. Open Godot.
2. Click the _Import_ button.
3. In the file dialog, navigate to the `reproduce-globals-error` folder, select the `project.godot` file, and click _Open_.
4. In the _Import Existing Project_ dialog, click the _Import_ button.
5. In the menu, click _Project_ > _Project Settings..._
6. Select the _Globals_ tab.
7. Select the _Autoload_ subtab.
8. Click in the _Node Name_ box and type a name (e.g. Test).
9. Click the _+ Add_ button.

**Actual Outcome**: An error will be written to the `Output` tab.

**Expected Outcome**: No error is written to the `Output` tab.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This is the project that minimally reproduces the error:

[reproduce-globals-error.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25720087/reproduce-globals-error.zip)

This is the project that does not have the error:

[working-project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25720109/working-project.zip)
